root_cause: The supervisor started after the official review had been imported. It created a transition without a native review checkpoint, then required that checkpoint to accept the already-approved official review, blocking forever with winner_review_identity_conflict.
fix: Only a complete authorized epoch1 official approval may adopt a missing checkpoint at the actual current reconciliation time. Existing checkpoints are never replaced or renewed; native approvals cannot create a replacement clock. Original official completion metadata stays separate from native model custody.
deterministic_causal_regression: With a complete synthetic official import, the pre-fix composed supervisor deterministically returned winner_review_blocked instead of winner_review_pending at checkpoint adoption. After the fix it advances to source choice/publication without a review broker call.
adjacent_controls: Reject native approval without owned checkpoint
deployment_scope: Local supervisor management binary only; no API deployment or migration is required for this fix.
